listingTitle: GORILLA GRIP Bath Rug Mat for Bathroom, Absorbent Chenille, 24x17 Grey
listingLines: AWARD WINNING: Winner of the 2026 HuffPost Shopping Awards recognizing excellence in the home category and problem solving products
SOFT AND THICK CHENILLE: pamper your feet with the softest, coziest chenille; measuring almost one inch thick, plush pile helps soothe feet and keeps toes warm from the cold floor below
ULTRA ABSORBENT: our most absorbent bath rug; dense chenille pile captures extra moisture helping to keep your floors clean while stepping out of the bath, shower, or standing at the sink

TEXTURED RUBBER BACKING: unlike other brands who use PVC or hot glue, our bath rugs are constructed with a durable TP Rubber Backing. PVC and hot glue break down as mats are washed whereas, our TP Rubber mats have been third party tested to be washed and dried over and over again for long lasting use

FADE RESISTANT AND DRIES QUICKLY: premium microfiber fabric is not only ultra absorbent but also dries quickly; plus, rugs are super easy to clean and fade resistant allowing you to machine wash and dry as often as needed; our rugs have also been given the Confidence in Textiles label, and have been tested for harmful substances according to OEKO-TEX Standard 100; performance, durability and emissions tested
summary: This GORILLA GRIP Bath Rug Mat is designed for your bathroom. It features ultra-absorbent chenille to capture moisture, helping to keep your floors clean. The soft, thick pile also pampers your feet and helps keep them warm from cold floors.

faq.question: What material is this bath rug made from?
faq.answer: This bath rug is made from soft, thick chenille with a premium microfiber fabric. It also features a durable TP Rubber Backing for stability.

faq.question: How well does this bath rug absorb water?
faq.answer: It is described as ultra absorbent, with a dense chenille pile that captures extra moisture. This helps keep your floors clean after baths or showers.

faq.question: Can I machine wash and dry this bath rug?
faq.answer: Yes, the bath rug is fade resistant and dries quickly, allowing you to machine wash and dry it as often as needed. Its TP Rubber backing has been tested for long-lasting use after washing.
